name: ProductionOrderOperatorPanel
tagline: A touch-first shop-floor job panel for Power Apps and Power Pages.
description: Operators see their work-centre queue, start, pause with a reason, resume and complete jobs, report good and scrap with reason codes and output lots, record batch-tracked material consumption and watch run time and rate vs standard – all saved as JSON for your ERP/MES integration.
features: Order queue with status, progress, due-date risk and priority
Start / Pause with reason / Resume / Complete with live run timer
Good and scrap reporting with reason codes, output lot, tolerance and short-completion confirmation
Material consumption with batches and shortage flags
Work instructions and event history with undo
Shift KPIs: good, scrap, yield, rate vs standard
Phone, tablet and desktop layouts; keyboard and screen-reader support
19 outputs and a DOM event for Power Pages
